# FlatBill — Lifetime Invoice & Estimate PDF Maker ($19.99 Once)

> FlatBill is an offline-first iOS & iPadOS invoice and estimate PDF maker built for contractors, handymen, plumbers, cleaners, and freelancers. Unlike $200-$360/year subscription apps, FlatBill offers 3 free PDFs/month and a one-time buyout ($19.99) with 0% payment processing fees (direct Zelle/Venmo/Cash/Check notes), 1-tap estimate-to-invoice conversion, on-site finger signatures, and dedicated page-2 job photo addendums.

## Frequently Asked Questions
- **Does FlatBill charge monthly subscription fees or take a cut of my client payments?** No! FlatBill never touches your money (0% card/ACH fees — list your own Zelle, Venmo, CashApp, Check, or bank details directly on the PDF) and offers a one-time Lifetime Pro buyout instead of $220+/yr rent.
- **Does FlatBill work offline in basements or rural job sites?** Yes, 100% offline. Client directories, item templates, signatures, and vector PDF generation run locally on your iPhone or iPad with zero account login required.
- **Will attached before-and-after job photos mess up my invoice table?** Never. FlatBill automatically places job photos with captions onto a clean Page-2 Photo Addendum so Page 1 stays crisp and professional.
